title: Remove pre-field Engram queued-row compatibility paths (513018d)
outcome: A local session's public queue and projection identity derive from the authoritative queued records, including when that queue is empty. Preserve the remote proxy's received queue and passive historical-store recovery.
acceptance: A local session with an empty authoritative queue exposes no queued prompts, regardless of stale embedded Session pendingPrompts. Public projection identity and cache validity derive from the same authoritative queue, and populated local queues keep their order and disposition.

A remote proxy still exposes its received pendingPrompts and queueProjectionHash. The historical persisted-row reader continues to distinguish proven promotion from unknown delivery and never automatically replays an unknown head.

Behavioral Rust regressions cover the empty local queue and warm cache, and focused committed checks pass for queue projection and retained-row recovery. The independent review pair and FULL pass on the exact landed input.
